action: Baker Tilly clients: read the notification letter, take up any credit monitoring offered, consider a credit freeze and watch for tax or identity fraud. Firms using Baker Tilly should ask which of their data was held by the provider.
exec: A supplier breach exposed client identity data; the supplier is unnamed and the total number affected is not yet published.
plain: Accounting firm Baker Tilly is telling clients that a company it uses had a security incident it learned of on September 6, exposing client details including Social Security numbers.
summary: The accounting firm is notifying clients that a service provider suffered a breach it became aware of on September 6 (the intrusion date is not stated), exposing client data including Social Security numbers. The provider is not named. A Texas filing lists 10,456 affected residents; the total has not been published.
title: Baker Tilly notifies clients of breach at a third-party provider

validation.note: Notification reported by two outlets; total affected not published.

review.note: Title, Sept 6 awareness, unnamed provider, Texas 10,456, SSNs, Nov 11 date checked against BleepingComputer and Privacy Guides
